content.rendered:
The WA6HAM Repeater System has affiliated with other repeaters in northern California that share the same philosophical outlook of providing the amateur radio community repeaters that can be used for public service activities.  These affiliate repeaters will be linked to the WA6HAM repeaters via Echolink.  Depending on pubic service activity coverage requirements, the affiliate repeaters will linked or unlinked as necessary by the system sysops.

Please stay tuned to the web site as we will be making announcements as the new repeater equipment comes on-line.
